name: Spotify Lyrics Ext
description:
Displays synchronized lyrics, track duration, and live audio stream metrics for Spotify in the top bar with a Full View Ubuntu App.

Improvements & Features:
* LRCLIB v2 (Beta) API: Lightweight search summary + individual /api/get/{id} lyrics retrieval with ±5s duration drift matching
* Full View Ubuntu App: Standalone dual-pane desktop app with album art, synchronized karaoke lyrics, playback controls, and aesthetic music icon
* Change Lyrics Selector: Easily browse top 10 candidate versions with hasSyncedLyrics status badges and manual selection
* Resilient Retry Polling: Staggered backup retries (1s, 3s, 6s, 12s up to 30s) gracefully handle transient API 503/network errors
* Added Quality Inspector: Zero-debug stream bitrate & payload calculation directly from active Spotify cache via Linux /proc
* Scrolling Animation: Right-to-left slide transition from title to lyrics, smooth vertical rolling between lines
* Live Duration & Bitrate: Shows track duration, measured bitrate, and stream size in the menu
* Clean Panel Presence: Automatically appears only when Spotify is running
